primary_source_findings.seeded_precoloring_disjointness: The defining roles of a seeded precoloring are pairwise disjoint.
formal_constructor: S(Q) is the union of all local representative vertices.
Z(Q) is the union of local Z(T,T') sets.
Q-admissible f' has domain S(Q) union Z(Q).
The displayed raw tuple assigns S union S(Q) to the seed role and X0 union Z(Q) to the precolored-X0 role.
No explicit Z(Q) minus S(Q) or precedence operation appears in the displayed formula.

source_001_discrepancy.completeness_paragraph: With N={y} and y in Y(T'), the proof writes (Y(T) intersect N(Y0)) minus N(y).
source_001_discrepancy.consequence: The 5-vertex 001+000 minimizer remains quarantined. The sealed 6-vertex 111+000 witness is the canonical authority witness for this gate.

question_A_hidden_invariant.claim: S(Q) intersect Z(Q)=empty for every relevant Q
question_A_hidden_invariant.scope: This refutes the hidden-invariant interpretation only; it does not refute Lemma 11 or the paper's main theorem.

normalization.name: LEGACY_SUPPORT_Z_ROLE_NORMALIZATION_V1

definitions.Y_new: (Y minus (A union Z_FORCE)) union (N(A) intersect Y0)
definitions.coloring: f union f', with f' still defined on A union Z_FORCE and all original Q-admissibility equations retained

normalization.principle: Role normalization only. Forced-color semantics are attached to Z_FORCE, not to membership in the physical X0 role.

proof: Legacy support A is contained in Y union Y0: P,N representatives lie in Y and M representatives lie in Y0.
Every legacy local Z(T,T') is contained in Y, hence Z_FORCE is contained in Y.
Original roles S,X0,X,Y0,Y are disjoint.
Original Y is partitioned into Y intersect A -> seed; (Z_FORCE minus A) -> X0 role; and the remaining Y minus (A union Z_FORCE) -> Y role.
Original Y0 is partitioned into A intersect Y0 -> seed; N(A) intersect Y0 -> Y role; and the remainder -> Y0 role, using the paper's convention N(A) excludes A.
Therefore S_new,X0_new,X_new,Y0_new,Y_new are pairwise disjoint and cover V(G).

N2_SEMANTIC_PRECOLORING_IDENTITY.identity: S_new union X0_new = S union X0 union A union Z_FORCE
N2_SEMANTIC_PRECOLORING_IDENTITY.consequence: Exactly the same vertices are fixed as in the literal constructor; only support/Z-overlap vertices are assigned to the seed role rather than simultaneously to two roles.

proof: The domain of f' remains A union Z_FORCE.
Every forced-color equation for every vertex in Z_FORCE is retained even if that vertex also lies in A.
Endpoint/support color constraints and the global properness condition are unchanged.
Hence the set of Q-admissible functions is identical to the literal definition for the same chosen Z_FORCE.
Take deletion set empty, which is allowed in the normal-subcase definition.
S is contained in S_new.
A is contained in Y union Y0, so S_new is contained in S union X union Y0 union Y.

Legacy 001 support is a Y endpoint with a seed neighbor; legacy 111 endpoints are in Y and the Y0 middle is adjacent to endpoints; thus every nonempty legacy support fragment attaches to connected S and G[S_new] is connected.
Z_X0 is contained in Y, so X0_new intersect Y0 adds no new Y0 vertex requiring an extra seed-neighbor check.
X0 is contained in X0_new and X0_new is contained in X0 union X union Y0 union Y.
The new coloring is f union f' on precisely the added fixed vertices.
N4_NORMAL_SUBCASE.note: This establishes normal-subcase typing/definition only, not downstream Lemma 7 or Lemma 10 transfer.

proof: The completeness witness c in Paper II already agrees with f' on A union Z_FORCE by construction.
The normalized tuple fixes the same union of vertices with the same colors as the literal tuple.
Therefore c extends the normalized raw tuple whenever it extended the literal intended precoloring data.
N5_COMPLETENESS_REPLAY.source_001_firewall: This identity does not choose between the two conflicting 001 Z formulas; it preserves whichever source-level Z_FORCE is separately determined.

proof: The family Q is unchanged.
S(Q) is unchanged.
Z_FORCE and the admissible-function set are unchanged.
The normalization adds only a set-difference projection Z_X0=Z_FORCE minus S(Q), computable in polynomial time.
Therefore Q-count, support bound, unique-Z-completion counting argument, construction size, and reconstruction asymptotics are unchanged.

scientific_interpretation.strongest_supported_statement: The literal displayed Lemma-11 raw constructor admits a verified support/Z role collision under the audited definitions. A minimal role-only normalization separating semantic forcing Z_FORCE from physical X0 placement Z_X0 restores seeded-precoloring typing and preserves the legacy raw precoloring/admissibility/budget interface at specification level.
not_claimed: that the authors intended this normalization
that the published final version contains no correction
that the paper's main theorem is false
that the normalization restores Lemma 7, Lemma 10, acceptability, or the full proof
